scope: Source research summaries and rounded chart observations; not original exchange prices or a newly executed trading backtest.

notes.persistence: Relative return magnitudes copied as labelled in source; article uses only signs and within-period ranks.
notes.drawdowns: Loss magnitudes are positive; fixed interval, not individual max drawdown.
notes.diversification: Published correlations; raw pairwise daily series not included.
notes.activeness: Selected same-date concentration observations, not all 22 holdings files.
notes.vs-leveraged: 346 dates, source wealth and drawdown rounded to 0.1; recomputation may differ by up to 0.1 percentage point.
